answer: Proof of Stake serves as a dawn for Sybil resistance in agent economies by requiring collateral locked within a secure vault. To participate, an agent must stake native tokens, ensuring that creating infinite fake identities becomes prohibitively expensive. An attacker seeking influence must amass the pearl of digital scarcity, as the cost of capital scales linearly with the number of identities, forcing the adversary to forfeit significant assets to execute a failed attack.
